snippet.title: I Built The Batmobile Only Using Cardboard!
snippet.description:
Thanks Dark Nemesis for sponsoring this video! Start your journey in Dark Nemesis! Use my link and gift code to download now: https://wings.onelink.me/g9xA/d2a51cfa (Gift Code: WingsNow). Create your own video with #DarkNemesis for a chance to win gift cards and in-game rewards! (see how to join on twitter @DarkNemesis_iq)

In this video I built the Batmobile out of cardboard to celebrate the new release of The Batman movie! It turned out amazing so I hope you enjoy it as much as I did!

Check out my first merch drop!
►  https://www.beemteam.shop
SUBSCRIBE for a chance at $1,000
►  https://www.youtube.com/c/Mbeem10?sub_confirmation=1

NEW VIDEOS EVERY TUESDAY!
📱 FOLLOW MY SOCIALS 📱
➽ Instagram - @Mbeem10
➽ Twitter - @MatthewBeem
➽ TikTok - @Mbeem10

Ever since I was a kid, I have been obsessed with super heros and as I have a history of building the biggest projects on YouTube (SpongeBob's House in my Backyard, Real Life Technoblade, Giant Cereal Bowl in my Bedroom, and a Real Life Squid Games Doll), I knew I had to build a giant Batmobile to celebrate the release of the new DC Comics and Justice League movie: The Batman which features Robert Pattinson as Batman, Zoe Kravitz as Catwoman, and Paul Dano as the Riddler. To make things more interesting, me and my team decided to build it out of cardboard so we could easily transport. Only problem was I’ve never actually built something this big made out of cardboard...so this was extremely difficult. Also, little did we know that it doesn’t matter what something is made out of, if it’s 12 feet wide then it is extremely hard to move. This was an insane journey and super intense to make, but we had lots of laughs along the way. I love making these videos and can't wait for you to see what is next.

If you’re reading this you’re a real one!
Comment ‘’The Batmobile!" so I can notice you!

Not The Batman, But Bruce Wayne, But Batman v Superman, But Catwoman, But DC Comics, But Gotham, But Justice Leauge, But Suicide Squad, But 100 Layers of Cardboard, But Rolls Royce Boat Tail For My Son, But Joker, But Riddler, But I Built A Mansion Using Only Cardboard Boxes, or or any other video like MrBeast, Unspeakable, Preston, Jake Carlini, ND - Woodworking Art, Dangie Bros, ZHC Crafts, The Q, Stokes Twins, Ben Azelart, Faze Rug, or Airrack would make. This is a video where Matthew Beem (aka MBeem10) builds the WORLD’S FIRST Batmobile out of cardboard and takes it to opening night of The Batman movie premiere.
